title: LET THE UNANSWERED REST
goal: Let an unanswered question remain unanswered while action continues from what is known.

steps.text: Notice the unanswered question.
Treat the event as one incident, not identity.
Leave extra work outside this round.
Describe the first action.
Bring forward only the question that needs action.

win: Extra work remained outside this round; only the question that required action was brought forward.
mindBend: An unanswered question can exist without becoming the owner of attention. Action depends on relevance, not total certainty.

title: NO SECRET MESSAGE
goal: Let an intrusive thought exist without treating its arrival as a message.

steps.text: Say, “A thought showed up.”
Add, “Showing up is not a message.”
Name one ordinary thing in front of you that has nothing to do with the thought.
Do that ordinary thing for ten seconds without checking whether the thought is gone.

win: The thought stayed unanswered while attention moved into an ordinary object and action unrelated to it.
